subject: Kickoff: Brush - portable Gaussian splatting to demo-ready
body:
Hi both,

Kicking off the Brush maturation effort for the vision portfolio. Brush is our 3D reconstruction engine using Gaussian splatting, and its differentiator is portability: it renders AND trains on macOS/Windows/Linux, in a browser, and on Android, via the Burn framework and custom WGSL kernels. Nobody else in the space demos on-device training - that's the wedge.

The README says it plainly: today it's a proof of concept, basic training only, none of the newer extensions. Goal for Apr 13 - Aug 3 is demo-ready, not feature-complete.

Milestones: M1 (May 15) stable ingestion of both zip formats - synthetic-NeRF-style with transform_train.json, and COLMAP with images + sparse folders. M2 (Jun 26) quality bar vs. reference implementation on standard scenes. M3 (Jul 24) browser + Android demo for the Launch Review Board.

Hyun is TL. Bao, staffing and the eval question are yours.

Lucia
